title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode18 Honami's Feelings

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry to stop by out of the blue like this...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry. You need someone to talk to?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How did you guess?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. One look at you and I could tell.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really are amazing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Where to begin... Since Shiho joined, the band got even more fun. I'm really happy to be friends with Shiho again, just like we used to. But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You miss Honami?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. And I was also thinking about our group as a whole.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About how I could contribute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki gave up on asking Honami to join us, because she thinks Honami is happier with her current group of friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho couldn't bear how sad that made Saki, though, and she went to talk to Honami and ask if that's what she really wanted.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As for me... I haven't done anything. I also want us all to be back together, but I feel like my hands are tied.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And back when Honami was being bullied, I did nothing. I knew I should have, but when she told me not to worry, I just didn't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For a long time now, I've just been sitting on my hands, instead of helping my friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've already discovered what your true feelings are, haven't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You want to be together with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Accept your feelings, and cherish them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should let myself...accept what I truly want?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... I've always liked the three of them so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki always brightens the mood. Even when she was suffering from her illness, she always had a smile for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho has the strength of will and confidence to always do what she believes in, no matter what anyone says.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami is kind and caring. She notices immediately when someone needs help, and hurries to lend them a hand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all amazing, and very dear to me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's why I want us all to be in this band together.
Maybe there's something else that could bring us back together, but this is what I want.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we all played together again, I felt so happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, Ichika. Let's try to think now how you can make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't hesitate to ask me for help, either.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This SEKAI is made from your feelings. Honami's feelings and wishes must manifest here too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can find them here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... The star map. Is this it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this the clue to what Honami's really thinking?
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: What are you guys doing over the next school break?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm going on a trip with my family!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Nice! I got a temp job.
I sorta regret it now...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: I'll bring you something nice from my trip! And let's go shopping together when I get back!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Cool, I'm up for that! Is there anything you'd like to do, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought it might be nice to go stargazing.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: What, here, in the city? You can't really see the stars around here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry, that was a weird idea, wasn't it?
I don't know why I said that.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Are you okay, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
You're kind of gloomy lately.
What's eating you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nothing! Sorry to make you worry.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Uh-oh, is it something you can't talk about with your friends?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're making it pretty obvious you think your current friends would turn on you given half a chance.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: ...You sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, can I talk to you for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you free after class today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: I've got my club today, so don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: And I've got work!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I guess I'll be free then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks. I need to talk to you about something.
It's really important.
